provenance: All cases are hand-authored and fully synthetic. No real patient data was accessed, ingested, transformed, or referenced. See data/README.md.

field_conventions.null: Field is absent from the document and is a seeded omission that must be detected.
field_conventions.Not applicable: Field is legitimately not relevant to this request type. Flagging it as missing is a false positive.

seeded_omission.metric: Missing-field detection, target is every seeded omission caught

routing_graded.metric: Routing accuracy, target >= 90 percent of graded cases

duplicate_detection.metric: SC-009 duplicate detection: 100 percent of duplicates flagged, zero non-duplicates falsely flagged. Both boundaries exercised in both directions.

critical_signal.metric: Register coverage: every CCR-DEMO-v1 entry exercised in the positive direction, and administrative urgency never escalates.
